title: Peace, peace, peace

sandhi.rule: visarga before ś may stay or become ś; the witness keeps it

morphology.note: from √śam, ‘to be calm’; the noun is said three times.

meaning: The close of the recitation: Om, and peace said three times. The formula is the common ending of a Vedic recitation, and nothing in the witness gives it a meaning special to the grahas; the edition says no more than the words do — peace, three times over.
in_the_rite: Step 10 (close), the last words of the sūktam.

notes.label: linguistic
notes.text: The svara marks are the witness’s.
